templates.why_chosen: A clean floor-level pipeline exemplar: 9 plain blue-outlined stage boxes in one strict left-right row from App Containers to Wire, with gray funnel icons marking the two places where per-core queues fan in.
templates.what_to_learn: When the point is just that packets pass through these layers in order, skip numbering and legends entirely, and reuse one small funnel or trapezoid glyph wherever parallel per-core resources converge instead of drawing every core's queue.
